text_block_list.text:
Super Creek is looking this way
with a sleepy expression...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Trainer-san, you really are such a good boy/girl...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I'm sorry.
I seem to have spaced out for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I need to pull myself together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You worked so hard to pick out this race for me, Trainer...
I need to do even more so I can win...

Saying so, Super Creek zoned out again,
looking half-asleep.
...Did I pack the schedule too tight? For the future's sake, it might be best to review her race schedule.
